title: Sparse Voxel Octree (SVO) Demo by Jon Olick
summary: A short demo of real-time sparse voxel octree rendering, shown by Jon Olick at Siggraph 2008. It shows a detailed model rendered by ray casting through the octree.
why: Cited in discussions of voxel rendering, id Software's research and Euclideon-style claims as an early demonstration of the technique.

quote.text: id actually demoed a voxel rendering system at SIGGRAPH 2008
